name: jcg-network-ts-platform
description: Vendor-neutral network troubleshooting and intelligence platform developed by Manny Colón for JCG Solutions.

commands.title: JCG Network TS: Public IP Lookup
JCG Network TS: Get My Public IP
JCG Network TS: IANA Port Calculator
JCG Network TS: Root Cause Analysis
JCG Network TS: Azure CIDR Analyzer
JCG Network TS: AWS CIDR Analyzer
JCG Network TS: GCP CIDR Analyzer
JCG Network TS: Select Windows Network Adapter

netCommander.ipinfoApiKey.description: Open a Free account at ipinfo.io website and get your free API key from your dashboard API Token and paste it here.

netCommander.ianaCsvUrl.description: This is the precompiled URL for IANA port assignments. Verify the URL at the IANA site and replace here if they update it https://www.iana.org/assignments/service-names-port-numbers/service-names-port-numbers.xhtml

netCommander.windowsAdapterName.description: Selected Windows network adapter for traffic monitoring (RX/TX)
netCommander.windowsAdapterName.markdownDescription: Run the command 'JCG Network TS: Select Windows Network Adapter' to populate this.

netCommander.azureGraphToken.description: Bearer token with access to Azure Resource Graph (management.azure.com).
netCommander.azureGraphToken.markdownDescription: Generate a token via Azure CLI: `az account get-access-token --resource https://management.azure.com/ --query accessToken -o tsv` and paste it here.

netCommander.awsAccessKeyId.description: AWS access key ID used by the AWS CIDR Analyzer.
netCommander.awsAccessKeyId.markdownDescription: Create a user or role with least-privilege access (for example, `ec2:Describe*` permissions) and provide the Access Key ID here.

netCommander.awsSecretAccessKey.description: AWS secret access key paired with the configured access key ID.
netCommander.awsSecretAccessKey.markdownDescription: Store the AWS secret access key associated with the access key ID. Rotate this credential regularly.

netCommander.awsSessionToken.description: Optional AWS session token for temporary credentials.
netCommander.awsSessionToken.markdownDescription: Populate when using temporary credentials such as those from AWS STS (`aws sts get-session-token`). Leave blank when using long-lived access keys.

scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run compile
scripts.dev:restart:
npm run compile && printf '
JCG build complete.
In VS Code: Shift+F5 to stop the current Development Host, then F5 to launch Run JCG Network TS Platform.

'
